en: I think he went to train at the volcano?
Victoria's been gone for a while.
What's with her?
...Unless it's something to do with him. Hm~
Kiki gave her life to save all of us?
...Let's make good use of our time and work hard.
Have you met Cal?
He's kinda weird, but kinda cool.
And by that I mean, kinda hot.
Oh, don't tell Victoria I said that!
It feels really lonely here now...
This is the main lecture hall, but we do a lot of classes outside, too. By the water, or on Pyrous Mountain, or in the Training Grounds.
It's like there's a field trip every day!
Is Kiki really gone?
I mean, she can't be, right?
She'll come back with some super-zen-ish power, somehow!
Like, "One must transcend life in order to transcend death!"
That sounds like something she'd say, right?!
I mainly come here to hike, but I'd never miss a chance to listen to Kiki's lectures.
She's like a sage, that girl.
I didn't know her that well, but even I'm going to miss her.
This is Kiki's room. But she's out at the moment.
Oh, you're looking for her?
Hm, well, she went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
You could probably try and catch her after the lecture.
They're basically right out the front door; can't miss them.
Kiki went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
VICTORIA: Azurine Island is just a skip east of here.
You took a boat here, right?
You should be able to reach it easily.
Whatever Team Meteor is up to, we've gotta stop them.
I'll keep everything steady here while you're out.
Kiki is currently resting and has asked not to be disturbed.
Victoria just ran out of here though; didn't you see her?
Kiki is currently amidst a lecture.
I cannot allow you to enter this way.
Please enter through the front to attend her lecture.
VICTORIA: Deep breaths...
\PN, I apologize to you on behalf of the academy.
You've been wronged.
I've never seen her fall apart so fast.
All of this is... a lot of firsts.
???: Victoria!
There's news.
VICTORIA: I'm kind of over news right now.
LETTIE: A couple of the students were hiking out at Azurine Island--
Apparently there's some suspicious folk over there?
Like full black suit and heavy machinery type suspicious?
VICTORIA: That'll be it.
Thanks, Lettie.
If anything else comes up, bring it to me.
Kiki is going to be resting for a while.
LETTIE: You got it, girlfriend!
VICTORIA: I have to stay here.
This school needs at least one person who can be honest and keep things moving.
And, although I'm furious at her right now,
So does Kiki.
Can you check on Azurine Island?
If anything else happens, or if that Machine turns up, I'll let you know as soon as I can.
No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
AME: \PN?
Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
Anyway...
AME: Oh, you're coming in from Apophyll Academy?
...It's true that that used to be a Gym, but not anymore.
Kiki was forced to retire due to some ongoing health concerns.
Are you sure the stress of battling won't be too much on her?
...Well, I suppose I can give you her old notes, just in case.
Thanks to her school's focus on meditation, the mental energy around there is out of this world!
When she uses Meditate, her Pokémon will be much, much stronger than normal, so don't give her that chance!
By the way, for beating the Fighting-type, although many people go for Flying-types, that could be a risky play.
With all the sand and ash down there, it's easy for it to get kicked up and vision to be lost. But Kiki's mentally focused Pokémon will often still land attacks!
Rather than Flying-types, try using the mental energy against her! Psychic-types can really do a number down there!
Good luck, whatever happens.
I've been looking forward to coming here for so long, and yet...
Many of the older students here say it's not what it used to be-- but it's still everything I'd imagined.
CAL: \PN.
CAL: I'm glad you're here.
The truth is, I was the one who passed the report of this going on to the Nightclub.
I probably could've done a lot to stop this, but...
...Well, how is she?
This was another Anomaly's doing, of course.
You just defeated it, and our star actor ran through here.
It's currently hiding in Kiki's room.
A Pokémon that can steal the feelings of others...
You can probably guess what it is, right?
With how much pressure she was putting on herself, when I found that thing...
It was willing to help, and I thought it might just do the job.
Show her that she's enough herself.
She doesn't have to keep trying to be someone else.
...It could've been a little nicer about it.
I'll go patch things up with Victoria. Make sure she's on the right path.
The Pokémon is all yours though.
Best clean it up before she tries to punch it or something...
Sorry for springing this on you but your help is, as always, irreplaceable.
VICTORIA: Oh, you're done already?
I was just... coming to check.
I can't say I'm really happy about Cal setting this whole thing up...
But it's over now.
The students have dispersed, and no one seems to really remember what happened...
...Which is just fine by me.
If you happened to forget it too, I can't say I'd mind.
But... he was right.
Maybe I did need to acknowledge that part of myself still.
Maybe it was... a little bit helpful.
Even if he's stupid and I hate him.
I don't hate him.
But I am mad at him, so don't tell him that!
If I'm acknowledging my feelings, he can acknowledge that he really needs to stop going behind people's backs, even if it IS for the greater good or whatever!
...Anyway, thanks for your help.
I'm going to... take some time and keep processing this.
I don't need to do it like Kiki.
I just need to do it like me.
That would be enough.
'Ey kid! You want me to teach your Pokémon some special moves? Take a look what I got!
Gastro Acid is gonna run you a single Blue Shard.
Recycle is gonna run you two Purple Shards.
Endeavor is gonna run you three Green Shards.
Pain Split is gonna run you three Red Shards.
Did you know?
The best place to train your Defense is by striking the Magcargo that bar Pyrous Mountain's lava flow!
Haaaaaah!
Gastro Acid
Recycle
Endeavor
Pain Split

... Eight.
CHARLOTTE: One, two...
CHARLOTTE: Eight...

Howdy, stranger.

It's even got a little cabin over on the bank.
Nobody's there, so I'm just gonna assume they don't mind me borrowin' it for a bit.
Maybe I can pay 'em in fish.
Oh, howdy partner.
I remember you from a ways back. You was the one that took my Old Rod, wasn't you?
Ever since then, I've been traveling all across Reborn looking for somewhere that the water was good, and lo an' behold, I've finally landed.
This place is some kinda peace, and look! It's even got a cabin off on the bank.
Howdy, partner.
You fixin' to do some fishin'?
Now say, come again? You were lookin' for bodies at the bottom of the lake?
Now you listen here, partner.
I'm not gonna ask questions no matter what I fish up, so don't you feel the need to kill me off as a witness or nothin'.
Yeah, yeah, I know, you didn't kill no one.
I get it. That's what they all say.
I'll-- I'll cooperate, don't worry.
But maybe you should know, I saw one of them Whiscash type things-- a real big'un too-- pullin' something around under the surface.
I didn't think much of it at the time, but now that you mention that's what's down there, that musta been what it was.
If you're missin' some kinda evidence you need to get back, it's possible that fish done ate it.
But it ain't gonna be no stroll around the lake to recover.
Here, why don't you take one of my spare rods?
If you fish up one of those Whiscash, bring it to me and I'll do the dirty work of searchin' it for you.
Fair warning though, there's a lot of Whiscash in this pond, so there's no guarantee we'll ever find it, if indeed that fish swallowed it.
Any luck scoungin' up one of them Whiscash from around here?
Ain't nothin' to do but keep tryin'.
All right, hand 'er over. If she's got anything of note, I can find it without hurtin' the thing.
Now, let's see...
Well, what've we got here?
This wouldn't happen to be what you're looking for, would it?
Glad I could help you out.
So that means you can let me live, right?
Nope, no dice. Go fish.
There's bound to be a lot of 'em in this lake, and any one of them coulda been the one that chompered it up, so ain't nothin' to do but keep on keepin' on.
We'll get 'em eventually, partner.
Hey there, partner!
I uh, I don't know nothin' about nothin'. Remember that, all right?
LAURA: Well, this is strange, isn't it?
Um, do try not to trample the flowers though?
I've spent quite a bit of time on them.
ANNA: Nostra and I believe in you, \PN!
ANNA: Nostra and I still believe in you, \PN!
NOEL: I don't really see the point of doing this just now, but...
I guess if you're ready, take your place.
CHARLOTTE: We're really doing this right here, huh.
So, this is gonna be a six-on-six Single Battle.
Either Trainer is allowed to make--
CHARLOTTE: Saphira!
SAPHIRA: Charlotte, you're here!
CHARLOTTE: Surprised to see ya, Sis.
SAPHIRA: And Anna, Noel...
You all escaped.
CHARLOTTE: Yeah, \PN and Shelly gave us a hand.
We've gotten away from the Doctor twice already.
SAPHIRA: We're gonna have to make it three times.
He's coming here.
Now.
And he's not alone.
He's got his orderlies and a full squad of men dressed in black with him.
CHARLOTTE: Team Meteor again.
SAPHIRA: The group is coming by foot and water both to cut off any escape.
LAURA: What should we do?
SAPHIRA: There's only one thing we can do:
Fight.
Listen up.
Charlotte, Anna, Noel, and--
Uh, you, other girl.
SHELLY: Um-- Um, my name is--
SAPHIRA: Not now.
Hurry and get inside, and find somewhere to hide.
CHARLOTTE: Hello? No way.
I'm not about to run and hide when I can melt their faces off here and now.
SAPHIRA: Overruled.
The Doctor still has potential legal authority over you, since you're not an adult yet.
We might be able to resolve the escape charge, but we don't want you to have to deal with resisting arrest too.
So leave this to us.
\PN, right? And Laura.
I'm charging you two with defending the house.
Anyone gets in, destroy them.
NOTHING is going to touch my family.
SAPHIRA: Good.
SAPHIRA: The point is, you find where the kids hide in the house and make sure no one else finds it.
Use force if necessary.
The Doctor is coming around the long way, but Team Meteor is on the water.
I'm sure they thought they were being clever.
But they've made themselves vulnerable.
I'm going ahead; I'll take down as many of them as I can.
You all assume your positions.
Dragonite, forward!
CHARLOTTE: So that's our older sister.
Pretty cool, right?
NOEL: We should hurry.
I can see them coming.
CHARLOTTE: Yeah, okay. Follow her lead!
Come on, everybody in!
NOEL: Okay. Nomos and I are ready whenever you are.
Like before, take your place.
SHELLY: Okay, okay. This will be a six-on-six-- Um, it's Singles, right?
Either Trainer can make substitutions, and um...
The battle will end when all six of one Trainer's Pokémon have been knocked out!
NOEL: Well, Nomos, do you think they can do it?
SHELLY: B-begin!
ANNA: Yay!! Great job, \PN!
Although, isn't it a little insensitive to win by starting a fire? I mean...
I guess as long as Charlotte and Laura don't find out?
It's okay! I won't tell them!
And Nostra says scorched earth is negligible on the overworld anyway... whatever that means!

\PN received the Standard Badge!
NOEL: By having the Standard Badge, Pokémon up to level 60 obey.
Additionally, I'm supposed to give you this.
NOEL: I'm sure you know, but Hidden Power's type changes based on the Pokémon using it.
It's useful to unlock inner potential... and stuff.
That's all, right?
LAURA: ........Did I miss something?
ANNA: \PN just beat Noel for a Badge!
SHELLY: How is Charlotte?
LAURA: She's fine, but I think she needs some time alone right now.

LAURA: Um, well........
It was a long time ago, but when Charlotte was very young, there was an accident.
Back then, we all lived together.
Charlotte, Saphira and I, and Mom and Dad.
She would sneak out late every night, usually just to play in the garden or stare out at the lake.
Nothing harmful.
And that was fine, because it was safe here.
But one night, she was playing with her Vulpix and........
As you can see, it's easy for a fire to spread in a place like this........
Saphira woke me up and rushed me out of the house just in time, but our parents didn't make it.
Ever since then, it's just been Saphira looking out for us........
Especially after the Doctor took us in.
She's kept us safe for years.
I really hope Charlotte's okay.
I don't know what I'd do if she--
If she were........
I'm sorry, I shouldn't cry.
I should be strong like Saphira........
ANNA: No, it's okay!
Cry all you need!
Tears are just one way of getting sadness out of the body.
C'mon, let's go inside, okay?
Nostra says you'll feel better if you have a snack and sit down.
LAURA: All right........
CHARLOTTE: Looks like I'll be refereeing this one.
If only to make sure nothing gets out of hand...
Does it really have to be here?
...Whatever.
If you're ready, tell Noel.
SHELLY: I guess-- I guess I'll be refereeing this one?
SHELLY: Hehe, I get to see another one of your Gym Battles.
Hey, hey, \PN, you'll rematch me someday, right, okay?
CHARLOTTE: ...
CHARLOTTE: It wasn't our fault.
It's easier to say than feel, but being here helps.
Easier to feel like I deserve to be.
It wasn't your fault.
CHARLOTTE: Anyway, enough brooding.
I wanted to show you our new friend.
CHARLOTTE: This one started following me around the Grand Hall last time I was there.
CHARLOTTE: This one kept following me around...
So, she's mine now.

...And Vulpix is still cute.
VULPIX: Pix!
NINETALES: ...Tai!
VULPIX: Pixpix!
CHARLOTTE: ...Good.

Fight me.
Fire Types or not, I plan on shooting up in rank.

Any news?
VICTORIA: ...A doctor will come by later?
That's probably best...

Am I sick...?

We just want to make sure you're holding up okay.

I need to find her...

I think I'd rather be doing something...

If I use my Pokémon to send an Air Slash up into the sky...
Um, she should come by...

I'll send the signal out, and then...

Did you want to have a Gym Battle?

Just, um...
Just come by whenever you're ready.

Half my age and twice as smart.

I couldn't stand to see her being treated poorly by others,

Both of us have been overlooked and looked down on.
At the end of the day, I just hope she gets through it better than I did.

If you're going to fight her, at least win on your first try.
That way it's minimal stress on her...

Are you doing all right?

I'm fine...

No hesitation.
Absolutely disgusting...

Is this necessary?

Come to think of it, why are you here, Cain?
Were you looking to challenge her as well?

I'm going to--

There was, um...

It's, um, just me...

CAL: Wait--
CAL: No, I'm--

SHELLY: U-um...

It was just a s-shove... and the couch is soft...
He didn't... mean to...

SHELLY: It-- it was my fault for getting too close anyway.
Leave us.

VICTORIA: S-sure thing...
Let's go, \PN...
"PULSE-07"

Anna, Noel, Charlotte.

zeL: Um, I-- I don't think they actually know...

...Hrm.
Zel: Behave, you stupid vermin!
zeL: Er, that is... Um...

Zel: You little...
